items.alt: We've increased the number of photos you can attach to a post from 4 to 10. That's why we're adding a carousel.

The carousel only shows for posts with at least 5 photos.
Old posts with photos will continue to show the regular grid layout.
Each photo displays a numbered badge to make it super clear there are more photos to browse.
We've improved the gesture handling so you don't accidentally open the drawer menu or go back/forward in your browser while swiping.
We're always eager to hear your feedback. Let us know your thoughts about the new carousel!

record.text:

external.title: Announcing Aster - a home for researchers on the open web

record.text:
The modern research ecosystem of online tools and communities is controlled by for-profit companies.

But we think that researchers should be the priority - not the product.

So, we're announcing Aster ID: not-for-profit Atmosphere account hosting for researchers.

We've increased the quality of photos in posts by doubling the max file size to 2MB and the resolution limit to 4000x4000. 

Plus, posts with multiple photos now appear in a carousel so you can show off your photography in all its glory.

Left side labeled "THE FEMINIST RELATIONSHIP MODEL" shows an illustrated woman in dominant position over a man, with text "Do what I say," "Equal roles equal power," "Be a good boy and take care of this," "Yes Queen." Yellow box states "HE'S ATTRACTED TO YOUR MASCULINE ENERGY." Red X marks list six negative outcomes including "He expects her to share responsibility" and "Often leads to tension, lost femininity and less intimacy." Green checkmarks list six positive outcomes including "He leads and makes decisions" and "This builds deeper connection, intimacy and loyalty
